# Orla 2.0.0

This release makes the native Windows taskbar the default integration mode. Windows keeps ownership of application buttons, grouping, focus, minimize/restore, jump lists, notifications, and multi-monitor behavior, while Orla provides its lightweight top bars and quick controls.

## Highlights

- native Windows taskbar with automatic hiding by default;
- optional legacy Orla dock available from the top-bar context menu;
- one-file, per-user installation with no administrator rights required;
- automatic startup and standard Windows uninstall registration;
- safe migration from previous Orla installation locations;
- English repository documentation; the interface still follows the Windows display language.
